title: Text clients can use function calling
summary:
The text API gained function calling and provider-backed streaming, with search handling tidied up behind them.

The text API now passes caller-supplied `tools` and `tool_choice` to OpenAI-compatible completions, returns tool calls for clients to execute, and preserves the fields needed to send function results back in a follow-up request.

Requests with `stream: true` can receive provider-backed, OpenAI-style server-sent events instead of waiting for a completed response. Streaming errors use a format clients can handle.

Non-streaming search continues to handle built-in web search and scraping calls on the server, while streaming search passes its configured tools to the model. Web-search requests now alternate between two configured Bing keys.

highlights.title: Function calling for text
highlights.text: Send `tools` and `tool_choice`, receive tool calls, then send function results back in a follow-up request. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Stream text responses
highlights.text: Set `stream: true` to receive text responses as OpenAI-style server-sent events instead of waiting for the full completion. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
